overview.problem: traktor_nml/gui/theme.py names 'IBM Plex Sans' and 'IBM Plex Mono' at the head of both font stacks and nothing in gui/ ever loads either face: no @font-face block, no stylesheet link, and IBM Plex among none of the 277 families installed on the machine. Measured on the served page, the app's sans stack renders at 485.5078125px for a test string - identical to system-ui and to Segoe UI - and its mono stack at 615.78125px, identical to Consolas; document.fonts holds only Material Icons and Roboto, both Quasar's. All ten artboards are IBM Plex, so the CSS asserts a typeface the page never uses. The gate that would have caught it looks past it: DL-084's served-page comparison admits a record whose verdicts are all atoms, and all four existing records are - 37 verdicts in the fullest of them, every 56px a button width and the only footer a focus-region name - while the artboards' three top-level structures, the 56px/1fr/64px app shell, the 1fr/400px main split and the card-h/card-b triplet, have no equivalent in gui/ at all.
overview.approach: Two subjects, one plan. The seven IBM Plex faces the artboard import line names - Sans 400/500/600/700, Mono 400/500/600 - are vendored under traktor_nml/gui/fonts/ with their OFL text and served by the application: theme.py owns the URL prefix and emits the @font-face blocks, app.py mounts that same constant, and the guards assert files, block counts and the mount argument rather than a family name, because a family-name assertion is true in exactly the broken state. Then DL-084 is amended to require a structural verdict per surface beside its atoms, a Composition not built section is opened for the structures the artboards draw and gui/ does not, and the four records are re-verdicted as statements of what each run did not measure - no readings rewritten and no new browser session. Building the missing layout is not in this plan; making the gap visible and recorded is. The reconstruct page at the root route is named as outside the structural gate rather than given an invented comparison, because no artboard draws it.

decisions.decision: The seven IBM Plex woff2 faces the artboards import - Sans 400/500/600/700 and Mono 400/500/600 - live in traktor_nml/gui/fonts/ and are served by the application itself
decisions.reasoning: design/reconnect-wizard/Main.dc.html:11 imports exactly those seven weights from fonts.googleapis.com -> the wizard runs under ui.run(native=True) as a desktop tool, where a CDN link resolves to nothing offline and reports nothing when it fails -> a silent CDN failure reproduces the present defect, so the faces travel with the package and the count is read off the artboard import line rather than chosen

decisions.decision: theme.py holds FONT_URL_BASE and emits the @font-face block; app.py mounts that same constant through app.add_static_files, so the URL is written once and read on both sides of the nicegui boundary
decisions.reasoning: an @font-face src and the route that answers it are one fact split across two files -> theme.py may not import nicegui (DL-069) and app.add_static_files is a nicegui call -> the constant lives in the nicegui-free module and the mount reads it, which makes a divergence between stylesheet and route a comparison of one constant against one call argument rather than two literals nobody compares

decisions.decision: The font guards assert the face files, their byte sizes and hashes, the seven @font-face blocks, the emitted ordering and the mount argument together; no guard treats a font-family name as evidence that a face loaded, and where a rule's font-family is read it is read as an identity check against theme.FONT_SANS rather than as a literal name
decisions.reasoning: document.fonts.check with a 14px IBM Plex Sans argument returns true today with no face present, and theme.FONT_SANS already names IBM Plex while the page paints Segoe UI -> an assertion that a name appeared is true in exactly the broken state, but an assertion that the body rule's font-family is the FONT_SANS constant itself is a wiring fact that changes when the stylesheet stops using the constant -> DL-173's body-rule check is admitted in that identity form and no guard anywhere infers paint from a name

decisions.decision: OFL.txt ships in traktor_nml/gui/fonts/ beside the faces and the vendoring provenance - upstream release and per-file SHA-256 - is recorded in traktor_nml/gui/README.md
decisions.reasoning: IBM Plex is SIL OFL 1.1, which requires the licence to travel with the fonts -> the faces are redistributed in the wheel and in a PyInstaller build -> the licence sits in the directory both packaging routes copy, so no route can ship the faces without it

decisions.decision: The faces are the upstream woff2 releases, committed unmodified and unsubsetted, and their provenance is verified rather than declared: the vendoring step names the IBM/plex release tag and the archive URL it downloaded, computes the SHA-256 of each file as downloaded, and tests/test_gui_font_assets.py recomputes the SHA-256 of each committed file and asserts it equals the hash recorded for it in traktor_nml/gui/README.md
decisions.reasoning: a Latin subset would cut the committed bytes but adds a build step whose output no upstream hash can verify -> a README that merely states a hash is a self-declaration nobody rechecks, and a file that drifted after vendoring would leave that statement looking true and being wrong -> the release tag and archive URL make the origin nameable and the guard makes the recorded hash a live assertion over the committed bytes

decisions.decision: pyproject.toml carries the fonts directory as package data and traktor-nml-spike.spec carries it in datas
decisions.reasoning: the setuptools packages list installs modules, not data files -> an installed wheel or a frozen build without the directory answers 404 for every face and falls back to Segoe UI silently -> both packaging routes name the directory, and the guard derives its expectation from the directory listing rather than from a transcribed list, following tests/test_packaging_gui_extra.py

decisions.decision: DL-084 requires a structural verdict per surface - app shell, column model, card structure, table geometry - beside the atom verdicts a record already carries
decisions.reasoning: the four records carry 37-plus matches verdicts and not one measures a layout structure: every 56px in them is a button width and the only footer is a focus-region name -> the artboards' three top-level structures, the 56px/1fr/64px shell, the 1fr/400px main split and the card-h/card-b triplet, have no equivalent in gui/ at all -> the gate as written admits a record silent on composition, so a surface without a structural verdict fails the gate rather than passing it

decisions.decision: Structural differs entries are recorded under a traktor_nml/README.md heading of their own, Composition not built, distinct from Framework shortfalls and Design-set divergences
decisions.reasoning: the three sections answer three different questions -> Framework shortfalls records a Specs rule the running framework refuses and Design-set divergences records prose governing an artboard value under DL-088, while a structure the artboards draw that gui/ never builds is neither refused nor superseded -> the section states its distinguishing test in its own opening: it holds work not done, and an entry leaves it by being built rather than by being re-argued

decisions.decision: Re-verdicting a record adds a structural verdict stating what that run did not measure and leaves every atom verdict as recorded
decisions.reasoning: a record is the transcript of one run against one served page at one commit -> rewriting its readings would assert measurements nobody took -> each record gains a section naming the structural surfaces the run passed over, so the re-verdict states the run's coverage and needs no new browser session

decisions.decision: The reconstruct page at the root route is outside DL-084's structural gate, stated in the amendment rather than left implicit
decisions.reasoning: all ten artboards are the reconnect wizard and the reconstruct page was never drawn -> Specs.dc.html covers its behaviour in prose under Splice conflicts - Reconstruct playlists and specifies no composition, and DL-088 makes prose govern -> a structural verdict there would compare against an artboard that does not exist, so the amendment names the exclusion and its ground

decisions.decision: The concrete cascade position DL-086's ladder records for gui/ rules is read out of traktor_nml/README.md and written into traktor_nml/gui/README.md as a named step before the body font rule is written; page_stylesheet() emits the @font-face blocks ahead of the body rule and emits that body rule at the recorded position, and the stylesheet guard asserts the recorded position appears in the emitted text and that the body rule's font-family value is the FONT_SANS constant itself
decisions.reasoning: Quasar's own CSS arrives in layers the page orders last and an unlayered add_head_html rule loses at every specificity (DL-086) -> a requirement phrased as the cascade position DL-086 requires names no layer and no !important so no guard can assert it -> reading DL-086 and recording the concrete position turns the requirement into a string the guard can look for, while the font-family check stays an identity against theme.FONT_SANS so it does not become the name assertion DL-165 forbids

decisions.decision: Before FONT_URL_BASE is fixed the plan reads the installed nicegui 3.16.0 source for app.add_static_files and records in traktor_nml/gui/README.md the module path and signature it found together with the version string; the mount premise is cited rather than assumed
decisions.reasoning: DL-164 rests on app.add_static_files serving a package-internal directory at a stable url_path and every font guard runs under the system interpreter which has no nicegui so no guard ever executes the mount -> an unread premise would fail only on a served page which is the gate this plan is trying to strengthen -> the reading is a named step of M-001 whose output is a citation in the README so a later nicegui upgrade has a recorded fact to be checked against

decisions.decision: woff2 with no woff or ttf fallback is the shipped format because the only engine that renders this app is the WebView2 or WebKit runtime pywebview embeds under ui.run(native=True); the engine and its woff2 support are named in traktor_nml/gui/README.md beside the format choice
decisions.reasoning: the faces are served to exactly one client which is the embedded browser engine the native window hosts -> both WebView2 (Chromium) and the WebKitGTK build pywebview uses on other platforms have supported woff2 since long before the versions this project can install -> a fallback format would double the committed bytes to serve a browser this application never opens so the single format is stated with its ground rather than left as a default

decisions.decision: The vendored directory's size ceiling is derived from measurement rather than chosen: the vendoring step measures the total bytes of the seven faces plus OFL.txt, writes that exact total into traktor_nml/gui/README.md, and tests/test_gui_font_assets.py asserts the directory total is at or under that recorded total plus five percent headroom; no magnitude is fixed before the measurement exists
decisions.reasoning: DL-167 promised the plan record a measured total but the faces are not vendored yet so no number exists at planning time -> a ceiling invented at planning time is a policy default with nothing behind it and would either pass everything or fail on a legitimate upstream file -> the ceiling is expressed relative to the number the vendoring step actually observes so it still fails on a subsetting drift or a wrong-format download while resting on a measurement rather than a guess

decisions.decision: Every documentation edit in this plan - traktor_nml/gui/README.md, traktor_nml/README.md, the four browser records and docs/CLAUDE.md - describes the file as it stands with no previously, now does, no longer or added, and each documentation milestone carries the grep acceptance that proves it
decisions.reasoning: a re-verdict is exactly where change-narration appears because the writer is conscious of amending an existing record -> the rule was carried only by M-002 leaving the font README and the four records unchecked -> the rule and its grep move to every milestone that touches a document so the check sits where the narration risk is

decisions.decision: The suite baseline is 534 passed and 3 skipped under the system interpreter which has no nicegui installed; the font guards therefore read source text and never import traktor_nml.gui.app, and the acceptance criteria name the numeric baseline rather than the count it stands at
decisions.reasoning: the app runs from .venv while the suite runs under the system interpreter -> a guard that imported app.py to inspect the mount would error on the nicegui import and be skipped which is a green run proving nothing -> the baseline numbers are recorded so a new skip is visible as a regression and the source-text form of the guards has its reason on the record

decisions.decision: design/reconnect-wizard/Main.dc.html line 11 is read as a named step before the literal seven is fixed, and tests/test_gui_font_faces.py parses that import line at run time: the family and weight pairs it names must equal theme.FONT_FACES exactly, with len(theme.FONT_FACES) == 7 and exactly seven @font-face blocks in the emitted stylesheet
decisions.reasoning: a guard that counts blocks against len(FONT_FACES) is satisfied by any tuple of any length -> a literal seven asserted with no reading of the artboard is a number the plan chose rather than the count the design imports, which is what the constraint forbids -> the guard reads the artboard import line so the shipped faces and the design's import cannot diverge in either direction and the literal seven stands as a second check on the same source

decisions.decision: M-001 closes with a served-page run from .venv whose pass condition is stated: document.fonts reports all seven IBM Plex faces with status loaded, the sans stack measures a width other than 485.5078125px and the mono stack a width other than 615.78125px, and neither new width equals the width the same test string measures in the system fallback stacks in that same session - Segoe UI for sans and Consolas for mono; the run writes those readings into docs/2026-09-05-plex-paint-record.md which carries structural verdicts under the amended DL-084
decisions.reasoning: the font guards prove wiring and not paint and only a served page can prove a face rendered -> a direction such as the widths move away from the recorded values passes on any drift including a shift to a third fallback face -> naming loaded status for all seven faces and a width distinct both from the recorded reading and from the fallback measured alongside it makes the criterion decidable from the readings the record itself carries

decisions.decision: The two invariants that had no enforcement gain guards in modules of their own: tests/test_gui_runtime_no_network.py walks traktor_nml/gui/ source for fonts.googleapis.com and any other scheme-bearing host in a runtime path, and tests/test_repo_state_invariants.py asserts the recorded digests of tests/baselines/manifest.json and fixture/w002gatefix2 and asserts that no module under tests/ or traktor_nml/ names a write path under build/ or dist/; the untouched-by-the-run half of that invariant stays test procedure because a pytest module observes state only at its own moment and has no recorded baseline to diff
decisions.reasoning: invariant 3 rested on a one-time acceptance grep and invariant 6 lived only in prose -> an invariant enforced by prose is enforced by whoever remembers it, but an assertion that a run touched nothing is not expressible from inside that run -> each invariant takes the strongest expressible form in a module named for it rather than riding on the font milestone's asset guard where an invariant unrelated to fonts would die with that file

decisions.decision: M-002 precedes both M-001 and M-003: M-001 closes with the DL-180 paint record, which is written under the AMENDED DL-084 and checked by the record-shape guard M-002 installs, and M-003's records name entries M-002 creates. M-001 and M-003 share no file and run in parallel with each other in the second wave
decisions.reasoning: M-001's paint record cites DL-169 and calls itself the first record written under the amended gate -> authoring it before the amendment exists would write it against the old procedure and before the guard that checks its shape -> the true graph is one root and two independent leaves rather than two independent starts, and the wave structure says so

rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Rejected by the operator: the wizard runs ui.run(native=True) as a desktop tool, so a CDN link resolves to nothing offline and reports nothing when it fails - a silent failure, which is the defect being fixed (DL-163).

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Install IBM Plex system-wide on the machine
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Rejected by the operator: it makes one machine right and every other machine wrong, and leaves the application still asserting a face it does not carry, so the CSS would keep naming a typeface the package cannot guarantee (DL-163).

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Drop IBM Plex from the stacks and let the app own system-ui
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Rejected by the operator: all ten artboards are Plex and DL-088 makes Specs' prose govern, so this would be changing the design rather than implementing it.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: File the structural differs entries under Framework shortfalls (DL-087)
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Rejected by the operator: that heading holds rules the running framework refuses, and these are work not done, so they take a heading of their own, Composition not built (DL-170).

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Build the missing layout now - the app shell grid, the 1fr/400px split, the card triplet, the table geometry, the footer band, the detail rail
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Explicitly deferred by the operator: this plan is option A, which makes the gap visible and recorded; options B, C and D are not authorised.

rejected_alternatives.alternative: Subset the faces to a Latin subset to cut the committed bytes
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Rejected under DL-167: subsetting adds a build step whose output no upstream hash can verify, and an unverifiable vendored binary is a worse failure than the size; the byte ceiling of DL-176 answers the size concern instead.

constraints: MUST: fonts are vendored and served locally; no request to fonts.googleapis.com or any other network host at runtime (DL-163, DL-181)
MUST: IBM Plex is SIL OFL 1.1 - the licence text ships beside the font files and the vendoring is recorded (DL-166, DL-167)

MUST: the weights the artboards actually import and no more - Sans 400/500/600/700 and Mono 400/500/600, seven faces - confirmed by reading the @import line in design/reconnect-wizard/Main.dc.html rather than assuming (DL-179)
MUST: the nicegui boundary (DL-069) - only app.py, file_picker.py and __main__.py may import nicegui; theme.py stays nicegui-free and keeps returning a stylesheet string (DL-164)
MUST: app.py stays 100% CRLF (1686 CRLF, 0 bare LF); theme.py and the tests are LF; read and write with newline=''
MUST: every guard is proven to FAIL first, and its docstring records the specific mutation applied and the specific output observed
MUST: a guard that asserts a font family NAME is not sufficient - the guard must read something that changes when the face fails to load (DL-165)
MUST: new decisions continue from the current high-water mark DL-162, re-read from traktor_nml/README.md and confirmed rather than assumed

MUST: the new heading for work-not-done is distinct from Framework shortfalls (DL-087) and from Design-set divergences (DL-088), and the decision that creates it says how a reader tells the three apart (DL-170)
MUST: documentation describes the code as it stands - no previously, now does, no longer, added (DL-177)

MUST: re-verdicting an existing browser record does not rewrite what that run measured; the original atom verdicts stand as recorded and the structural verdict states what that run did not measure (DL-171)

MUST NOT: regenerate the parity manifest (tests/baselines/manifest.json) or the gate fixture (fixture/w002gatefix2); never restore a file with git checkout; never write into or delete build/ or dist/ (DL-181)

MUST NOT: build the missing layout structure - the app shell grid, the 1fr/400px main split, the card-h/card-b triplet, the review table column geometry, the footer band, the detail rail; this plan makes the gap visible and recorded
MUST NOT: change the reconstruct page's composition or invent an artboard for it; the plan states the exclusion (DL-172)
SHOULD: the suite runs under the SYSTEM interpreter at 534 passed / 3 skipped, not .venv; the system interpreter has no nicegui and the app itself runs from .venv (DL-178)

risks.risk: A body font rule injected through add_head_html loses to Quasar's Roboto default, which arrives in a layer the page orders last (DL-086's specificity ladder). The faces load and the page still paints Roboto.
risks.mitigation: DL-173: page_stylesheet() emits the @font-face blocks ahead of the body rule and places that rule at the cascade position DL-086 records for gui/ rules; tests/test_gui_font_faces.py asserts the ordering and the cascade position in the emitted text, with a mutation that moves the body rule above the blocks.

risks.risk: The vendored woff2 total is unmeasured at planning time, so the repository could take a size nobody agreed to, or a wrong-format download could pass unnoticed.
risks.mitigation: DL-176: a 600000-byte ceiling on traktor_nml/gui/fonts/ asserted by tests/test_gui_font_assets.py, with the exact measured total written into traktor_nml/gui/README.md by the step that first measures it.

risks.risk: DL-164 assumes nicegui's app.add_static_files serves a package-internal directory at a stable url_path, and no guard can execute the mount because the system interpreter running the suite has no nicegui.
risks.mitigation: DL-174: the installed nicegui version, module path and signature of app.add_static_files are read from the installed distribution and cited in traktor_nml/gui/README.md before FONT_URL_BASE is fixed; DL-180's served-page run exercises the mount for real.

risks.risk: app.py is wholly CRLF against an otherwise-LF tree; a careless rewrite of the _page_chrome mount normalises it invisibly.
risks.mitigation: Every read and write of app.py takes newline=''; tests/test_gui_line_endings.py fails on the first bare LF and is named in M-001's acceptance criteria.

risks.risk: The differs list could grow past what this plan authorises, drifting from recording the gap into arguing for building it.
risks.mitigation: DL-170 fixes the section's scope - one entry per structure the artboards draw that gui/ does not build, each naming its artboard file and selector - and the entries leave by being built rather than by being re-argued; building the layout stays out of scope.

risks.risk: woff2-only could fail in the engine the native window embeds, leaving the faces unusable at exactly the place they matter.
risks.mitigation: DL-175: the pywebview-embedded WebView2 or WebKit engine is named in traktor_nml/gui/README.md as the sole client and its woff2 support is the stated ground; DL-180's served-page run reads document.fonts in that engine.

invisible_knowledge.system: Serving the page is the only gate that has ever caught a defect in gui/ (DL-084), and this plan's second subject is that the gate as written admitted four records that measured atoms and said nothing about composition. Every gui/ guard reads source text or walks the module graph; none exercises a served page, which is why an assertion on a font-family name would pass over a page painting Segoe UI. The layout in gui/ is pinned by source-text guards asserting exact .classes() literals, each with a mutation-control twin, so a layout change to a guarded call site is a two-file change by construction - one reason building the missing structure is a separate piece of work from recording it. Quasar's own CSS arrives in layers the page orders last, so an unlayered add_head_html rule loses at every specificity (DL-086's ladder): a body font rule naming FONT_SANS can collide with Quasar's Roboto default, which is why DL-173 makes the block ordering and the cascade position facts the stylesheet guard reads. The suite runs under the system interpreter at 534 passed and 3 skipped and that interpreter has no nicegui - the application itself runs from .venv - which is why every font guard reads source text rather than importing app.py (DL-178).
invariants: theme.py, and every gui/ module other than app.py, file_picker.py and __main__.py, imports neither nicegui nor webview; an AST walk in tests/test_gui_view_boundary.py enforces it (DL-069)
traktor_nml/gui/app.py is wholly CRLF against an otherwise-LF tree; every read and write of it takes an empty newline argument, and tests/test_gui_line_endings.py fails on the first bare LF

No runtime path in gui/ reaches a network host: the faces answer from a route the application mounts out of its own package directory; tests/test_gui_runtime_no_network.py walks gui/ source and fails on fonts.googleapis.com or any other scheme-bearing host (DL-181)

The count and weights of the vendored faces are read from design/reconnect-wizard/Main.dc.html's import line, not chosen; tests/test_gui_font_faces.py parses that line and asserts the pairs it imports equal theme.FONT_FACES, so a weight the artboards do not import cannot ship (DL-179)

A served-page record's readings are the transcript of one run at one commit and are never rewritten; tests/test_docs_browser_record_structure.py holds a digest of each record's atom reading lines and fails when one is altered, and a later judgement is added as a statement about that run's coverage (DL-171)

tests/baselines/manifest.json and fixture/w002gatefix2 are not regenerated and no file is restored with git checkout; tests/test_repo_state_invariants.py asserts both recorded digests and asserts no module under tests/ or traktor_nml/ names a write path under build/ or dist/. That a given run touched nothing is not observable from inside that run and stays test procedure (DL-181)
tradeoffs: The faces are committed unmodified rather than subset to Latin: the repository carries more bytes, and in exchange every vendored file is byte-identical to a named upstream release and verifiable by hash, with no build step whose output nothing can check

The font guards prove the wiring - files present, blocks emitted, ordering held, mount argument shared - and not the paint. Only a served page can prove a face rendered, so DL-180 makes a served-page run from .venv reading document.fonts and re-measuring the two defect stacks an acceptance criterion of the font milestone, and its record is the first written under the amended gate.

The structural gap is recorded rather than closed. The plan buys an accurate account of what the wizard does not build and defers the building, which leaves the Composition not built section holding entries for as long as the work waits

One rule, one guard: the record-shape check lives with the milestone that states the rule, so the re-verdicting milestone ships with no test of its own rather than with a second copy that could disagree with the first

readme_entries.content:
## Design Decisions

DL-163 - The seven IBM Plex woff2 faces the artboards import - Sans 400/500/600/700 and Mono 400/500/600 - live in traktor_nml/gui/fonts/ and are served by the application itself. design/reconnect-wizard/Main.dc.html line 11 imports exactly those seven weights; the wizard runs under ui.run(native=True), where a CDN link resolves to nothing offline and reports nothing when it fails.

DL-164 - theme.py holds FONT_URL_BASE and emits the @font-face blocks; app.py mounts that same constant through app.add_static_files. An @font-face src and the route that answers it are one fact split across two files, and theme.py may not import nicegui (DL-069), so the constant lives in the nicegui-free module and the mount reads it.

DL-165 - The font guards assert the face files, their byte sizes, the @font-face blocks and the mount argument together; no guard asserts a font-family name. document.fonts.check returns true for an absent Plex face and theme.FONT_SANS already names IBM Plex while the page paints Segoe UI, so a name assertion is true in exactly the broken state.

DL-166 - OFL.txt ships in traktor_nml/gui/fonts/ beside the faces and the vendoring provenance - upstream release and per-file SHA-256 - is recorded in traktor_nml/gui/README.md. IBM Plex is SIL OFL 1.1 and both the wheel and the frozen build copy that directory.

DL-167 - The faces are the upstream woff2 releases, committed unmodified and unsubsetted. Subsetting adds a build step whose output no upstream hash can verify, and an unverifiable vendored binary is a worse failure than the size.

DL-168 - pyproject.toml carries the fonts directory as package data and traktor-nml-spike.spec carries it in datas. A wheel or frozen build without the directory answers 404 for every face and falls back silently.

DL-169 - DL-084 requires a structural verdict per surface - app shell, column model, card structure, table geometry - beside the atom verdicts a record already carries. A surface with atom verdicts alone fails the gate.

DL-170 - Structural differs entries are recorded under a heading of their own, Composition not built, distinct from Framework shortfalls (a rule the running framework refuses) and Design-set divergences (a value the prose supersedes under DL-088). An entry here is work not done and leaves by being built.

DL-171 - Re-verdicting a record adds a structural verdict stating what that run did not measure and leaves every atom verdict as recorded. A record is the transcript of one run against one served page at one commit.

DL-172 - The reconstruct page at the root route is outside DL-084's structural gate, stated in the amendment rather than left implicit: no artboard draws it and Specs' prose, which governs under DL-088, specifies no composition.

DL-173 - The @font-face blocks and the body font rule are emitted so they win against Quasar's Roboto default, at the cascade position DL-086's ladder records, and a guard asserts that ordering in the emitted text.

DL-174 - The installed nicegui version and the module path and signature of app.add_static_files are read from the installed distribution and cited in traktor_nml/gui/README.md before FONT_URL_BASE is fixed, because no guard under the system interpreter can execute the mount.

DL-175 - woff2 ships with no woff or ttf fallback: the only client is the WebView2 or WebKit engine pywebview embeds under ui.run(native=True), and both have supported woff2 since long before any version this project installs.

DL-176 - The vendored directory carries a 600000-byte ceiling asserted by guard, and traktor_nml/gui/README.md states the exact measured total the vendoring step observed.

DL-177 - Every documentation edit in this work describes the file as it stands, with no previously, now does, no longer or added, and each documentation milestone carries the grep acceptance that proves it.

DL-178 - The suite baseline is 534 passed and 3 skipped under the system interpreter, which has no nicegui; the font guards therefore read source text and never import traktor_nml.gui.app.

DL-179 - The stylesheet guard asserts the literal seven: len(theme.FONT_FACES) == 7 and exactly seven @font-face blocks, so dropping a weight cannot leave the guards green.

DL-180 - The font work closes with a served-page run from .venv reading document.fonts for the seven faces and re-measuring the two stacks that recorded the defect, written up as the first record under the amended gate.

DL-181 - The network-host invariant and the repository-state invariant gain guards rather than resting on a review-time grep and on test-procedure prose.

DL-182 - The font work and the gate amendment share no file, artefact or output and run in parallel; the only real edge is the gate amendment before the re-verdicting, whose records name entries and are checked by the guard that amendment installs.
